desc: This vessel has unique micro-forges situated throughout the hull.  These micro-forges consume vast stores of materials to rapidly produce small repair drones en masse to rebuild the hull and critical components.  This ship regenerates %s/%s/%s/%s hull every second in combat. While the peak performance time of this ship greatly reduced due to this system, the repair drones allow the ship to hold onto its combat readiness far longer than normal.  Ship is almost always recoverable if lost.
short: Inbuilt micro-forges allow the repair of the ship's hull within combat, increasing engine and weapon repair, and reducing crew causalties
